author: mertch
text: Hi traders, I wanted to take the same trade I've took yesterday on UCAD but this time I was looking UJ. I've draw my FL as usual, then wait for price to comeback at level / FL. I've set my PO at FO, SL 1 pip below FL then wait and see. I was so sure the price would bounce inside FL but surprise, it went down 0.001 below it and bounce back higher. Great! it was time to test IF's theory on engulf. So I've wait for price to go back to next QM level, took a manual entry, price went to DM level and begun to go back down. In conclusion, even a fraction is an engulf, it will fly to the next FL at first occasion, there is nothing more to say.
